message.content:
I don’t have real‑time market data, so I can’t give you the exact spot price of gold for today.  For the most up‑to‑date figure you can check one of the following reliable sources:

| Source | Typical URL |
|--------|-------------|
| **Kitco** | https://www.kitco.com/ |
| **Bloomberg** | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets/commodities |
| **Reuters** | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities |
| **London Bullion Market Association (LBMA)** | https://www.lbma.org.uk/ |
| **U.S. Treasury or Federal Reserve** | https://www.federalreserve.gov/ |

These sites update the spot price of gold (usually quoted in U.S. dollars per troy ounce) several times per minute during market hours. If you need the price for a specific time or historical data, those platforms also provide charts and archives.
message.reasoning: User asks: "What is the gold price today in USA?" We need to provide current gold price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources. We can also provide a typical price range. But we should not fabricate. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Suggest checking websites like Kitco, Bloomberg, etc.
